notes: EP_genomewide.chinput: genome-wide promoter capture Hi-C on the CHiCAGO hg19 HindIII design, 22,076 baits, 119.8 M rows. Scores from the chinput route; default threshold 5 (202,625 calls). Class EX, no Python counterpart: exit status and non-empty outputs are gated; the chinput-versus-matrix agreement and score sanity were measured outside the harness (report).

EP_genomewide_cpp.cool: the same chinput as a fragment-level cool (hicConvertFormat --inputFormat chinput, derive_capture.sh); bait-to-bait pixels hold 2N. Scores from the matrix route, threshold 3. Class EX, no Python counterpart: exit status and non-empty outputs are gated; the chinput-versus-matrix agreement and score sanity were measured outside the harness (report).
